status: design_for_next_collection; exact source groups, target table, capacity and admission still required
basis: step7_clock_diagnosis_v1: fixed mapping SDC response measured; no changed mapping in tested ABC range
SDC: explicit varying query condition; ranges and feature interactions qualified from new target/load measurements
IO_policy: formal profile proportional 0.2 * SDC period, explicitly distinct from fixed-300ps diagnosis
reference_scale: freeze a predictor/table derived only from eligible training/validation before target generation; actual test Tmin, failed old test labels and formal PPA forbidden
pressure_point_meaning: probe locations relative to a frozen pre-backend reference, not universal saturation/repair boundaries or claims of intrinsic Tmin
source_grouping: all targets and repeated measurements of each source family stay in its original split; no row-random split
packing: single-core or similar predicted pressure only; retain separate per-interval QD and whole IO timing evidence
models_to_compare: simple structure/width/load baseline calibrated from relatively loose observations
conditional model adding SDC and static reference-pressure/load interactions
complexity_selection: validation under actual target/load conditions; prefer the simpler eligible model; a zero target response is allowed if independently validated
calibration: eligible train/validation only, including interior-width cross-fit; freeze reserve before independent test; evaluate validation eligibility after reserve
acceptance: retain original per-interval error and false-feasible gates; additionally report actual-target local and whole-path feasibility, ranking and conservative rejection
domain: release only qualified fixed-ABC target/load relationships; no unmeasured extreme-target extrapolation, no inferred two-dimensional ABC/SDC rectangle
independence_claim: new load/source/target contexts at previously exposed widths; not unseen-width generalization
production_query_scope: current shared pipeline chain implies one capture bank; multi-bank experiments do not add a new runtime architecture
dependencies: ordinary operation/state/overhead models must cover the same target context before complete native D qualification
old_failed_test_policy: sealed and permanently excluded from fitting/calibration/algorithm or margin selection
diagnostic_data_policy: 24 clock implementations and prior capacity probes remain not_training
formal_comparison: same case, same L and same absolute targets across C/D; no final-PPA reselection
